notes: Retest mode: ran the full backend pytest suite first (28 passed, 3 new files added this iteration), then re-ran all pre-existing named browser checks by name only, adding two new browser checks and three new backend test files to cover this iteration's briefing (refactor pass 5 on the live-turn path, the ElevenLabs proxy split, scenario generation/dashboard helper extraction, and the ReplyComposer/CategoryDeltas extraction).

New backend test files: test_tscheck_live_turn_guard.py (multi-turn recording, empty-utterance 422, turn-on-completed-call 409 — complements the existing after-End 409 coverage in test_tscheck_end_simulation_hard_stop.py), test_tscheck_voice_speak_proxy.py (known-character 200+headers, anonymous 401, over-cap 422, unknown-character fallback success, /voice/cast 8-verified-voices), test_tscheck_scenario_and_dashboard.py (Practice My Business profile+custom-scenario->simulation, and dashboard shape/consistency before and after a completed call).

New browser checks: reply-composer-turn-error-retry (route-intercepted 502 on /turns proves turn-error + retry-turn-button render and recovery), scorecard-category-deltas-render ('Run this exact prospect again' twice to get 2 attempts, then asserts attempt-category-deltas renders >=1 delta-* row).

coaching-report-full-render was flaky on first run only because the fixed 5s toBeVisible timeout in the persisted script is short relative to the briefing's stated 10-40s grading latency for this environment; it passed cleanly on immediate re-run with no code changes. Not classified as a bug (LLM grading latency variance, not a functional regression) but worth loosening that wait if it recurs.

BusinessSetup hook-order fix is exercised end-to-end by business-objection-suggestions-memo, which reaches the Objections step and completes the chip add/remove flow without a React hooks-order crash — this is the strongest evidence available for a fix framed as 'no crash on this exact page path'.

spec_deviations from the briefing (un-split SkillModule/BusinessSetup/Team's other tabs, decorative index keys, bearer token in localStorage, anonymous 401 on /api/auth/me) remain accepted as intentional, not flagged as bugs.

Console noise across all checks was limited to the expected anonymous 401 probe on GET /api/auth/me, the expected 409s from intentional concurrency/hard-stop tests, and the expected 502 injected by reply-composer-turn-error-retry's own route interception.
